tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm neutral, chroma 0.006. Dark theme is a warm dark grey (L 0.235), not black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, sidebar. Sits on bg, separated by a border token, never a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, ghost button hover, table headers.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline 1px around cards and between rows. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edge of inputs, checkboxes, switch tracks and secondary buttons: ≥3:1 on bg, surface and surface-subtle in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings: 16.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, metadata, labels: 6.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions, checked shopping items: 5.1:1 on bg, still AA.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: HØEM blue. Primary buttons, links, the Ø of the logo, Home module, focus ring. 5.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected navigation item, brand badges.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-tint: 9:1.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any solid module or status fill (meals, shopping, expenses, success, warning, danger).

tokens.name: meals
tokens.usage: Meals module accent (OKLCH L 0.52, C 0.14): icons, active tab, solid buttons with on-accent text. ≥4.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: meals-tint
tokens.usage: Meals soft background: badges, selected cards, icon tiles.

tokens.name: meals-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on meals-tint: ≥8:1.

tokens.name: shopping
tokens.usage: Shopping module accent (OKLCH L 0.52, C 0.14): icons, active tab, solid buttons with on-accent text. ≥4.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: shopping-tint
tokens.usage: Shopping soft background: badges, selected cards, icon tiles.

tokens.name: shopping-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on shopping-tint: ≥8:1.

tokens.name: expenses
tokens.usage: Expenses module accent (OKLCH L 0.52, C 0.14): icons, active tab, solid buttons with on-accent text. ≥4.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: expenses-tint
tokens.usage: Expenses soft background: badges, selected cards, icon tiles.

tokens.name: expenses-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on expenses-tint: ≥8:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status colour for success, positive changes. Always paired with an icon and a label, never colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Soft background for success badges and banners.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success-tint: ≥8:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status colour for pending states and warnings. Always paired with an icon and a label, never colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Soft background for warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-tint: ≥8:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status colour for errors and destructive actions. Always paired with an icon and a label, never colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Soft background for danger badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger-tint: ≥8:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element (:focus-visible).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and bottom sheets. Content beneath stays visible but inert.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Big numbers and the dashboard greeting. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text. Never smaller for paragraphs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, chart axes. Minimum size in the product.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows' inner elements.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; gap between rows of a form.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (airy density).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, avatars, toggles.

stroke.note: Layers are separated by borders, never by shadows.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Card and control borders.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, offset 2px.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons: also the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside dense rows (desktop only).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in badges and metadata.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Navigation and empty states.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop navigation sidebar.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: bottom tab bar becomes sidebar.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: two-column dashboard.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop: content max-width 1200px.

motion.note: Every duration collapses to 0s under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hovers and toggles.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets and modals.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Easing for every transition.
